svg.aria-label: Use: in the agent's chat you type /jano make this repository's README. Jano asks three questions one after another, who reads it, whether to keep an unfinished feature, whether to show a real screenshot, each with the answer it suggests marked. You pick, the question counter fills one, two, three, and then a bar shows Jano working on its own with no more questions.
svg.text: You answer once. Jano does the rest.
Each question comes with the answer Jano suggests.

g.text: then it works on its own
